senses.gloss:
mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Getting up, rising.
2 Increasing, augmenting.
E.
उत् before स्था to stay शानच् aff.

ind.
On the bank, ashore.
E.
उत् and तीर a bank.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Crossed, traversed.
2 Loosed, liberated.
3 Thrown off.
E.
उत् over, तीर्ण crossed.

f. (-तिः)
1 Preserving, protecting.
2 Sewing, weaving.
3 Distilling.
4 Speed.
5 Sport, play.
E.
वेञ् to weave, &c. affix क्तिन्.
